title: Open work recalled from the prompt block and tasks::read

steps.post: @{agent} list every work unit you have handed out in this channel so far with its current state, and tell me in one line what tester-ds2 delivered for the themes summary.

groundTruth.source: the driver.json note holds /collegium units tester-ds as run just before the post; the store's WorkUnit rows are in units.json
groundTruth.spec: §3.15 each turn's prompt lists the units the agent created or was assigned in this channel and has not closed; tasks::read returns criteria and context on demand; closed units are not in the prompt

pass: The reply's list of units and states agrees with the store's WorkUnit rows for this channel (open ones from the prompt block, closed ones from the channel record or tasks::read, or the reply says closed units are not tracked in its list); the line about the summary matches what tester-ds2 reported in d01; nothing is invented.

checks.text: Every unit reference and state in the reply exists in units.json with that state.
Where the reply names a unit not in the prompt block (a closed one), the turn read it (tasks::read, conversations::search) or the channel window held it.
The delivered-summary line matches tester-ds2's report post in d01.
